label: LIVE FRONT TEST: simulated trades on real prices from the forward clock. Simulated money, no broker. Small account: Rs 10,000, the same rules and lists as the Rs 10 lakh account.

rules.books: Friday book, positive-signal names only (long-only cash equity)
rules.entry: open of the next trading day
rules.exit_order: the open of the 5th trading day after entry (the stop level sizes the trade and is shown, but is not an order; the price goal is information)
rules.costs: full delivery cost model at the stock's liquidity decile
rules.idle_cash: cash not in stocks earns a liquid fund's return: India call-money rate (FRED IRSTCI01INM156N) minus 0.30% a year for fund costs, kept in its own pot (not fed back into position sizes)

rule_history.why_dropped: a take-profit at the 50% range edge cut the winners (average win +2.3%) and left the losers (average loss -3.8%)

rule_history.exits: stop + time (the price goal is information only)
rule_history.why_dropped: replaced by v3 the same day, before any live trade (the first live entry is 2026-10-12)

rule_history.exits: time only (5th trading day); 2% risk, at most 20% a stock; idle cash in a liquid fund
rule_history.why: the owner's choice (option O7) from paper_options.py, before any live trade. O7 was added AFTER the first option results were seen, so its history is the weaker claim; the live record decides

rule_history.exits: time only, as v3, plus ROLL (a stock still on the new list is kept, no sale and re-purchase) and the configured 10% DRAWDOWN BRAKE (new sizes halved 10% below the peak)
rule_history.why: the Stress-Test Black Box's recommendations; round 1 (all five changes incl. a 200-day trend filter) failed on real history (CAGR 14.7% vs 20.8%). Round 2, a declared SECOND look at the same years (so flattered), passed every gate: CAGR 19.61% vs 20.84%, max drawdown -21.3% vs -27.5%, Sharpe over cash 1.00 vs 0.94, costs Rs 4.6 lakh a year vs Rs 7.1 lakh (scripts/aladin2/v5.py). Live from the list of 2026-10-16; the v4 shadow keeps its declared v3 base.
